style: A still frame from a 1990s Japanese TV anime, hand-painted cel animation; hand-inked thick-and-thin outlines with slight wobble, flat two-tone cel shading with hard-edged shadow shapes, no gradients, no airbrush, no glossy highlights; limited palette black, warm off-white, one crimson red; film grain and cel dust. Not 3D, not digital painting, not semi-realistic. No text, no watermark.
